feedback: Without news access I can't tell whether a +14.6% pre-market surge on 12.5M shares (INSM) is a buyout, where the price pins, or a data or approval event, where it drifts. A headline field in the digest, or even a flag for "halted/news pending" would help. The scan tool does not say whether a stock reports earnings today or yesterday, so the earnings-gap logic has to be inferred. An earnings calendar flag would improve gap-drift trade selection. The 'extend' action is ambiguous about the reference price for stops and targets when no fill happens (I assumed the open).
